SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. 1. Special Branch Station,
REPORT
Date April 12, 1937.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE File No... REGISTRY M. S. B. D. 7867 63 / 37）

Subject Information regarding a Chinese named Tung Ya Non.

Made by D. S. Kamashita Forwarded by J. Boyne D.S.S.

The local Japanese Consular Police have received the
following information regarding a Chinese named Tung Ya Non
(唐里農) from the Kobe Police, Japan, :-
Tung Ya Non, aged 28, native of Kwangan Hsien (廣安縣),
Szechuen, arrived in Kobe from Shanghai on board the s.s.
"Nagasaki Maru" on March 9, 1937, but the Police Authorities
prohibited his entry into Japan and sent him back to
Shanghai aboard the s.s. "Rokko Maru", which sailed from
Kobe on March 11.
In July, 1929, Tung first arrived in Japan from China
with a view to receiving further education in Tokyo and in
April, 1930, he was admitted to the Waseda University. In
September, the same year, he was arrested by the Tokyo
Metropolitan Police on a charge of being a member of the
Anti-Imperialists League. Tung was released after three
monthes detention. Towards the end of 1931 he returned to
Kwangan Hsien, where he taught in a middle school until he
left for Japan in 1937.

FILE
D.S. 2/4

D. Kamashita
D. S.

D. C. (Special Branch).

事由：关于一名名为唐里農（Tung Ya Non）的华人的情报。

由 D. S. Kamashita 制作，经 J. Boyne D.S.S. 转呈

当地日本领事警察从日本神户警方获悉以下关于一名名为唐里農（Tung Ya Non）的华人的情报：

唐里農，28岁，四川廣安縣人，于1937年3月9日乘“长崎丸”号轮船从上海抵达神户，但警方当局禁止其入境日本，并将其遣返上海，乘坐的是3月11日从神户启航的“六甲丸”号轮船。

1929年7月，唐首次从中国抵达日本，旨在东京接受进一步教育，并于1930年4月进入早稻田大学就读。同年9月，他因涉嫌为反帝同盟成员而被东京警视厅逮捕。唐在被拘留三个月后获释。1931年底，他返回廣安縣，在一所中学任教，直至1937年再次前往日本。

档案
D.S. 2/4

D. Kamashita
D. S.

D. C. （特别分股）。
